what_this_is: G-3 — the patch record for the constrained-instruction runner (mechanism (a)). The frozen public runner is NOT modified.

built_on.why: it already carries the host paths, the gate precondition, the checkpoint/resume hardening and the standard outputs; starting from it keeps the two patched runners from drifting apart

patches: the contract table is defined next to the instruction it supplements
CTI-VSP is not a surface of this runner: it has its own instrument and its own reference
the CTI-VSP population is not loaded by this runner
the CTI-VSP reference import is optional here, and required only when that benchmark is run
CyberMetric-500's prompt carries the contract immediately before the answer cue
SecQA-v1-test's prompt carries the contract immediately before the answer cue
CTI-MCQ's prompt carries the contract at the tail, after the question
CTI-RCM's prompt carries the contract at the tail, after the CVE description

mechanism_a.what: a per-surface output contract APPENDED to the benchmark's own prompt, in the imperative, at the tail so it sits adjacent to the generation point
mechanism_a.why_not_just_state_it: the CTI prompts ALREADY state the contract in their head (CTI-MCQ: 'The last line of your answer should contain only the single letter...'; CTI-RCM: 'Ensure the last line of your response contains only the CWE ID'). The models do not comply. So the change is the constraint's STRENGTH and POSITION, not its content.
what_is_not_changed: the questions, the options and the CVE descriptions
the parser (the frozen runner's own parse_reply)
the decoder, the batch size, the padding side and the precision
the chat template, the 0-shot setting and the input-truncation setting

unchanged_by_design: the batch size (8) and the left-padding/attention-mask surface
bfloat16, no quantization, PEFT adapter NOT merged
parse_whole_mcq and parse_last_line, byte for byte
summarize()'s accuracy logic and the paired statistics
